matching: NFKD-normalize, drop combining marks (general category M*), lowercase, then split on any code point that is not a letter or digit (categories L* and N*). A term, processed the same way, matches when its words appear consecutively in the text's words. Fails closed: apostrophes split words.
source: OURS: possible-evidence pre-screen. A match sends the report to no model and shows the team protocol (do not touch, hold the line, call it in). Errs toward flagging.
